subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Promotion Uplift Modeling
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Promotion Uplift Modeling.

hook.text: A 30% discount doubled sales this week. But next week, sales dropped 40%. The promotion just shifted demand.

buildup.text: Promotion uplift modeling estimates how much extra demand a promotion creates above the baseline.

discovery.text: It separates genuine new demand from pull-forward—customers buying early instead of later.

twist.text: Promotions create spiky demand that stresses warehouses, transport, and production. The uplift has a hidden cost.

climax.text: Modeling uplift and post-promo dip together gives a true picture of promotion value.

punchline.text: A promotion moves demand in time. Not all of it is new.

quiz.question: What is pull-forward demand?
options: New customers buying for the first time
Customers buying early because of a promotion
